newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Obchodni bank cuts main lending rates 10 bps.
newsitem.headline: Czech Obchodni bank cuts main lending rates 10 bps.

text.p: Czech Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s., one of the Czech Republic's four largest banks, said on Wednesday that it was lowering its main lending rates by 10 basis points, effective March 3.
The bank said in a statement that its prime rate would drop to 11.75 percent, while its base rate for credits of up to one year would ease to 12.0 percent.
It added that credits between one and two years would be 12.25 percent as of March 3, and that two-three year credits would be 12.5 percent.
The move follows the trend on the local money market, where Prague Interbank Offered Rates (PRIBOR) have decreased by some 60 basis points since the beginning of the year.
On Wednesday the PRIBOR rate for six-month funds stood at 12.39 percent, while one year money was trading at 11.49 percent. -- Alan Crosby, Prague Newsroom, 42-2-2423-0003
